$description: Lumen v0.13 — Phase 0 semantic text namespace. Aliases the existing v0.12.6 `color.text.*` semantic tokens (in color.dark.tokens.json / color.light.tokens.json) under a flatter `text.*` namespace that Phase 0+ code can consume directly. The master doc names 5 roles (primary, secondary, tertiary, accent, inverse); Lumen v0.12.6 also ships placeholder/disabled/error/success/warning/link, all of which are preserved here. Both namespaces are kept — additive, not destructive.

primary.$description: Body and titles. Light: #141414. Dark: #E6E6E6 (the user-fixed brand light). 17.2:1 / 15.5:1 — AAA. Aliases color.text.primary.

tertiary.$description: Hints, eyebrow labels. AA Large only on dark (≥18px). Aliases color.text.tertiary.

accent.$description: Spring-green inline emphasis. Light: #008A4D (4.6:1 AA). Dark: #4DFFA8 (10.4:1 AAA). Aliases color.text.accent.

inverse.$description: Text on inverse surfaces. Aliases color.text.inverse.

success.$description: Inline success copy — reuses accent ramp (spring green is action/live/success). Aliases color.text.success.
